snapshotSubject: Let locale packs overlay vanilla pack item names.
notes: Packs overlay prose fields only. Leave ItemID, SaveName, LivingEntityType, StaticPrefabType, SaveAliases, AutoOrganizeString, Complexity, IsDefault, datapad ID, armor ItemType / set Name / piece Set, and combat stats in English. Container gump titles are not overlayable yet. Datapad English is XML in the game; this JSON is the overlay snapshot. Armor English is Config/ArmorSetData.json in the game; the overlay uses the same shape. Vanilla pack-item Name/Description stays in LoadedContent item_*.json; export-pack-item-prose.py fills the sol.* overlay fields in this InventoryItemData snapshot. Unique EquipmentEffects Description is still pack-only.
